protocol.scheduling: Serialized fresh-process ABBA blocks; all selected rows in each process

timing_scope.fit_seconds: rd.Model.fit(observations), including transactional graph staging, learned preprocessing, washout, features and solve; outer model construction/cloning excluded
timing_scope.history_forecast_seconds: rd.Model.forecast(history=history,horizon=...,compile=False), including original-unit transforms, reset/history, generated steps and output assembly
timing_scope.reservoir_forward_seconds: Optional public reservoir reset_state + forward on complete input prefix; no hooks or readout

protocol.data: Baseline-generated synthetic sine/cosine only; input_steps includes washout; observations=input_steps+1; targets shift by one
protocol.weight_construction: Only baseline reference preparation applies spectral_radius=0.7; measurement placeholders use spectral_radius=None before strict checkpoint loading and logical-weight equality checks
protocol.initial_weight_comparison: Only initial logical recurrent weights normalize zero signs because CSR drops structural signed zeros; raw artifact bytes, fitted-model tensors, predictions and states remain exact
protocol.inference: float64 CPU, no_grad, eval, no execution hooks; one verified native thread
protocol.claims: Implementation timing and exact fixed-artifact regression only; no accuracy tuning, universal speed, cold-compile or common memory claim
